welcome_page.title: Walking – Your surroundings
welcome_page.image_alt: #Person walking and a route between two points
welcome_page.description:
Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and how places look when you walk.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?

options.text: Not at all
Slightly
Moderately
Very
Extremely

questions.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: Nothing, it doesn't affect me
I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of on foot)

questions.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

questions.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, what do you do when streets, stops or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: It doesn't affect me
I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some stops or stretches
I stop using that route altogether

questions.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
questions.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
Sometimes they affect my mood
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

it.#Your surroundings: Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, how: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, quanto ti disturba o ti infastidisce il rumore del traffico?
it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Prendo un altro percorso o mi sposto in un altro orario
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in autobus invece che a piedi)
it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, cosa fai di solito quando il tempo è brutto (pioggia, vento, freddo o gran caldo)?
it.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Non cambia niente, mi sposto come sempre
it.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: È meno piacevole, ma mi sposto allo stesso modo
it.#I prepare differently or change route (: Mi preparo in modo diverso o cambio percorso (ad es. vestiti, ombrello)
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto o autobus)
it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, cosa fai quando strade, fermate o percorsi sono sporchi o mal tenuti (rifiuti, cattivi odori, vetri rotti)?
it.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Me ne accorgo, ma vado avanti come sempre
it.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: È spiacevole, ma passo lo stesso da lì
it.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Evito alcune fermate o alcuni tratti
it.#I stop using that route altogether: Smetto del tutto di usare quel percorso
it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, l’ambiente intorno, piacevole o sgradevole, influisce su come ti senti?
it.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Per esempio edifici, piazze, quanto un luogo è curato e la sua atmosfera in generale.
it.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ci faccio caso, ma raramente fanno differenza
it.#Sometimes they affect my mood: A volte influiscono sul mio umore
it.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Influiscono molto su come mi sento lungo la strada
it.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: A volte scelgo un percorso perché è più bello o più interessante
it.#Person walking and a route between two: Persona che cammina e un percorso tra due punti
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Mi proteggo, ad es. con una mascherina
it.#Walking – Your surroundings: A piedi – Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#SmartUrbanity - Walking – Your surround: SmartUrbanity - A piedi – Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#<p>Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and:
Rumore, aria, maltempo, pulizia e aspetto dei luoghi quando cammini.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome e non vengono inviate a nessuna amministrazione pubblica.

fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, how: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, dans quelle mesure le bruit de la circulation vous dérange-t-il ?
fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, que faites-vous quand l’air est mauvais (gaz d’échappement, poussière, mauvaises odeurs) ?
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Je prends un autre itinéraire ou je me déplace à un autre moment
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en bus plutôt qu'à pied)
fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, que faites-vous habituellement quand le temps est mauvais (pluie, vent, froid ou grande chaleur) ?
fr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Rien ne change, je me déplace comme d'habitude
fr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: C'est moins agréable, mais je me déplace de la même façon
fr.#I prepare differently or change route (: Je me prépare autrement ou je change d'itinéraire (par ex. vêtements, parapluie)
fr.#I put off or skip some trips: Je reporte ou je saute certains trajets
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en voiture ou en bus)
fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, que faites-vous quand les rues, les arrêts ou les chemins sont sales ou mal entretenus (déchets, odeurs, verre brisé) ?
fr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Je le remarque, mais je continue comme d'habitude
fr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: C'est désagréable, mais je passe quand même par là
fr.#I avoid some stops or stretches: J'évite certains arrêts ou certains tronçons
fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, un cadre agréable ou désagréable influence-t-il ce que vous ressentez ?
fr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Par exemple les bâtiments, les places, l'entretien d'un lieu et son atmosphère générale.
fr.#No, I don't pay attention to them: Non, je n'y fais pas attention
fr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Je les remarque, mais elles font rarement une différence
fr.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Elles influencent beaucoup ce que je ressens en chemin
fr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Je choisis parfois un itinéraire parce qu'il est plus agréable ou plus intéressant
fr.#Person walking and a route between two: Personne à pied et un itinéraire entre deux points
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Je me protège, par ex. avec un masque
fr.#<p>Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and:
Le bruit, l’air, la météo, la propreté et l’aspect des lieux lorsque vous marchez.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom et ne sont transmises à aucune administration.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, how: Wie sehr stört oder ärgert Sie Verkehrslärm beim Gehen oder Fahren im Rollstuhl?
de.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Was tun Sie beim Gehen oder Fahren im Rollstuhl, wenn die Luft schlecht ist (Abgase, Staub, schlechte Gerüche)?
de.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Ich merke es, ändere aber nichts
de.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Ich nehme eine andere Route oder fahre zu einer anderen Zeit
de.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Ich nutze ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Bus statt zu Fuß)
de.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Was tun Sie beim Gehen oder Fahren im Rollstuhl normalerweise, wenn das Wetter schlecht ist (Regen, Wind, Kälte oder große Hitze)?
de.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Nichts ändert sich, ich bin wie gewohnt unterwegs
de.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: Es ist weniger angenehm, aber ich bin auf dieselbe Weise unterwegs
de.#I prepare differently or change route (: Ich bereite mich anders vor oder ändere die Route (z. B. Kleidung, Regenschirm)
de.#I put off or skip some trips: Ich verschiebe oder streiche manche Wege
de.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Ich nutze ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Auto oder Bus)
de.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Was tun Sie beim Gehen oder Fahren im Rollstuhl, wenn Straßen, Haltestellen oder Wege schmutzig oder schlecht gepflegt sind (Müll, Gerüche, Glasscherben)?
de.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Ich merke es, mache aber wie gewohnt weiter
de.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: Es ist unangenehm, aber ich gehe trotzdem diesen Weg
de.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Ich meide manche Haltestellen oder Abschnitte
de.#I stop using that route altogether: Ich nutze diese Strecke gar nicht mehr
de.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: Beeinflusst eine angenehme oder unangenehme Umgebung beim Gehen oder Fahren im Rollstuhl, wie Sie sich fühlen?
de.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Zum Beispiel Gebäude, Plätze, wie gepflegt ein Ort ist und wie er insgesamt wirkt.
de.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ich merke es, aber es macht selten einen Unterschied
de.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Sie beeinflussen stark, wie ich mich unterwegs fühle
de.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Manchmal wähle ich eine Strecke, weil sie schöner oder interessanter ist
de.#Person walking and a route between two: Gehende Person und eine Route zwischen zwei Punkten
de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Ich schütze mich, z. B. mit einer Maske
de.#<p>Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and:
Lärm, Luft, Wetter, Sauberkeit und das Aussehen der Orte, wenn Sie zu Fuß unterwegs sind.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und Sie können jede Frage überspringen. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft und an keine Behörde weitergegeben.

tr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Fark ederim ama her zamanki gibi devam ederim
tr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: Hoş değil ama yine de oradan giderim
tr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: Yürürken veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle ilerlerken hoş veya hoş olmayan çevre kendinizi nasıl hissettiğinizi etkiliyor mu?
tr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Örneğin binalar, meydanlar, bir yerin ne kadar bakımlı olduğu ve genel havası.
tr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Fark ederim ama nadiren bir fark yaratırlar
tr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Bazen daha güzel veya ilginç olduğu için bir güzergâh seçerim
tr.#Person walking and a route between two: Yürüyen kişi ve iki nokta arasında bir güzergâh
tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#<p>Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and:
Yürürken gürültü, hava kalitesi, hava koşulları, temizlik ve yerlerin görünümü.

Katılım gönüllüdür ve istediğiniz soruyu atlayabilirsiniz. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez ve hiçbir kamu kurumuna gönderilmez.

fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با خودرو یا اتوبوس)
fa.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: هنگام پیاده‌روی یا حرکت با ویلچر، وقتی خیابان‌ها، ایستگاه‌ها یا مسیرها کثیف یا نگهداری‌نشده‌اند (زباله، بوی بد، شیشه شکسته) چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: متوجه می‌شوم، اما مثل همیشه ادامه می‌دهم
fa.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: ناخوشایند است، اما باز هم از آنجا می‌روم
fa.#I avoid some stops or stretches: از بعضی ایستگاه‌ها یا بخش‌هایی از مسیر دوری می‌کنم
fa.#I stop using that route altogether: دیگر اصلاً از آن مسیر استفاده نمی‌کنم
fa.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, do p: هنگام پیاده‌روی یا حرکت با ویلچر، آیا محیط خوشایند یا ناخوشایند بر حال شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#For example buildings, squares, how car: مثلاً ساختمان‌ها، میدان‌ها، میزان رسیدگی به یک محل و حال‌وهوای کلی آن.
fa.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: متوجه آن‌ها می‌شوم، اما به‌ندرت فرقی ایجاد می‌کنند

fa.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: گاهی مسیری را انتخاب می‌کنم چون زیباتر یا جالب‌تر است

fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: از خودم محافظت می‌کنم، مثلاً با ماسک
fa.#<p>Noise, air, weather, cleanliness and:
سر و صدا، هوا، آب‌وهوا، پاکیزگی و ظاهر مکان‌ها هنگام پیاده‌روی.

شرکت داوطلبانه است و می‌توانید به هر پرسشی پاسخ ندهید. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شوند و به هیچ نهاد دولتی فرستاده نمی‌شوند.
